details:
FireTrack is an advanced, real-time wildfire monitoring and early warning platform powered by NASA satellite data. By seamlessly integrating near-real-time thermal anomaly feeds from NASA FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System) with localized meteorological data and high-resolution terrain analytics, FireTrack detects active wildfires faster and accurately models their spread trajectory.

Our platform transforms complex satellite and environmental data into actionable, live interactive maps. This equips emergency responders, forestry management agencies, and vulnerable communities with critical lead time to coordinate evacuations, allocate firefighting resources effectively, minimize ecological destruction, and ultimately save lives.

Key Capabilities & Features:

  • Rapid Thermal Detection: Utilizes NASA MODIS and VIIRS satellite data to pinpoint heat anomalies within minutes of ignition.
  • Predictive Spread Modeling: Combines wind speed, humidity, vegetation density, and topographical elevation to forecast fire behavior and direction.
  • Instant Alert System: Delivers automated, geo-targeted early warnings to local authorities and residents in high-risk zones.

Project Roadmap & Timeline:

  • Phase 1: Data Integration & Core Engine (Months 1–2): Establishing real-time API connections with NASA FIRMS, integrating regional weather/topography datasets, and building the backend infrastructure.
  • Phase 2: Predictive Modeling & UI/UX Development (Months 3–4): Developing the AI-driven fire spread algorithm and designing an intuitive, live-mapping dashboard for web and mobile platforms.
  • Phase 3: Pilot Testing & Calibration (Month 5): Deploying the beta version in high-risk pilot regions, running historical fire simulations, and refining alert accuracy based on responder feedback.
  • Phase 4: Full Deployment & Community Onboarding (Month 6): Launching the public alert system, onboarding local emergency teams, and scaling the platform for broader regional coverage.
